Name: Hunter x hunter Phantom troupe
Author: Amatorxa
Description:
𝐃𝐞𝐬𝐜𝐫𝐢𝐩𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧:
[color=#D4D4D8]Add your favorite characters (if the Phantom Troupe happens to be your favorite— like in my case, lol) to the game as separate NPCs.[/color]

𝐈𝐦𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐚𝐧𝐭 𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝐛𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐮𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐦𝐨𝐝:
-This mod is still in𝑒𝑎𝑟𝑙𝑦 𝑟𝑒𝑙𝑒𝑎𝑠𝑒 𝑠𝑡𝑎𝑔𝑒 (version 1.0), so some bugs may still be present!.

English is not my first language, so there may be mistakes in sentence - 𝔰𝔬𝔯𝔯𝔶

If none of that has put you off, (I'm very glad about that)                                                                                                                                Keep in mind that in the official canon, 𝑤𝑒 𝑘𝑛𝑜𝑤 𝑣𝑒𝑟𝑦 𝑙𝑖𝑡𝑡𝑙𝑒 𝑎𝑏𝑜𝑢𝑡 𝑡ℎ𝑒𝑠𝑒 𝑐ℎ𝑎𝑟𝑎𝑐𝑡𝑒𝑟𝑠. As a result, I’ve had to rely heavily on the limited information available—sometimes exaggerating certain details for a joke or imagining new traits that could fit these characters. 

  𝐼𝑛 𝑠ℎ𝑜𝑟𝑡, you could call this a very 𝙝𝙚𝙖𝙙𝙘𝙖𝙣𝙤𝙣 Phantom Troupe mod, take it with a grain of salt . Have fun!



[img width=263]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55636/55636-1794843373-338913227.png[/img]

For now, we have a 𝑚𝑜𝑑𝑒𝑠𝑡 𝑠𝑒𝑡𝑢𝑝: two members of the Troupe!

Any information regarding the schedule and events will be in the game files.


[img width=263]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55636/55636-1794998061-496798041.png[/img]



I think it’s worth noting that...[i] for now[/i], the characters only go up to 8 hearts. I know, I know—[b]put your tomatoes away[/b]!


[img width=74]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55636/55636-1794869384-1118005893.png[/img]

 I didn’t want to write a million extra marriage-related dialogues just yet—[i]coming up with the regular ones was already quite a challenge[/i]. However, if I see that there’s interest in the mod, I’ll expand it so that the candidates become fully functional NPCs.


[img width=300]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55636/55636-1794998082-848534174.png[/img]


[i]The mod also includes various other additions, such as:[/i]

-Clothing inspired by the Phantom Troupe style [i](Modestly, I’ve only made a few garments so far)[/i]

[i]-[/i]Additional items related to the world of HxH [i](and beyond—wink, wink), such as weapons, books, etc.... well, you’ll find out in the mod![/i]

-Additional dialogue for [b][i]vanilla NPCs [/i][/b]regarding our anti-heroes, as well as specific extra dialogue for Phantom members in which they talk about one another.

[i]-[/i][i]a new map that will contain the spiders' base.[/i]

[img width=228]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55636/55636-1794998210-1123051559.png[/img][img width=280]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55636/55636-1795005026-1890902654.png[/img]


End of page:

It would be so cool to create each member of the Phantom Troupe and build a whole gang for the game—though...[b] that might be a challenge[/b], since I don’t have ideas for some of them, and [i]I don’t even like some of them [/i] (fck you Hisoka, I’m talking about you!). 

So, we’ll see how it goes! [i]If you have a favorite character you’d like to see in the game[/i], feel [b]free[/b] to share in the comments!—I’d love to read your thoughts. Any ideas you had what to add it would be great to have your help with the creative process!


Anyway, [i]have fun[/i]— that’s why I did all of this.
